drug_class: Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor (VEGF) Inhibitor - Recombinant Fusion Protein

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase bleeding risk due to antiplatelet effects; aflibercept increases thrombotic and hemorrhagic risk
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin E supplementation to <400 IU daily; monitor for bleeding signs

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties may potentiate hemorrhage risk with VEGF inhibitors
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on bleeding precautions

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet effects compound aflibercept's thrombotic/hemorrhagic risk profile
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue high-dose garlic supplements; monitor CBC and bleeding indicators

caution_supplements.name: Fish oil/Omega-3 supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effect; may slightly increase bleeding tendency
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bleeding or bruising; no discontinuation required typically

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response and bleeding parameters if concurrent use desired

avoid_foods.name: High-dose herbal teas (feverfew, ginger root)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Natural antiplatelet compounds may increase bleeding risk
avoid_foods.action: Counsel patient to limit consumption; avoid concentrated herbal preparations

caution_foods.name: Ginger (culinary amounts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects at high dietary intake
caution_foods.action: Monitor if consuming in therapeutic quantities; normal culinary use is acceptable

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cabbage)
caution_foods.mechanism: High vitamin K content may interact with any concurrent anticoagulation
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent intake; inform if patient on concurrent anticoagulants

monitoring_notes: Ziv-aflibercept is a large recombinant protein not subject to hepatic CYP metabolism; interactions are primarily pharmacodynamic (bleeding/thrombotic risk). Monitor for hypertension, proteinuria, and hemorrhagic events; counsel on bleeding precautions and avoid antiplatelet/anticoagulant supplements unless clinically indicated.
